direction: Shouldn't we place these ideas in REM-CD-ingest-001? As long as we maintain backward compatibility with the pre-existing embedding configurations, these other services will work as is. That is the premise and point which I would like to ensure we agree on.

contract.configuration: Retain embedding_pool and maintained non-pool configurations, existing bindings/default/profile selection and embedding APIs; no required ingestion-specific model service.
contract.omitted_new_fields: Qualified artifact-bound readiness may supply capabilities without mandatory user YAML edits; missing field syntax alone does not disable a qualified service.
contract.readiness: Qualify maintained baseline configurations operationally. Inability to establish required capabilities is a readiness stop for maintainer disposition, not a compatibility pass or authority for unguarded fallback.
contract.namespace: Services may differ in name and resilience while sharing a compatible embedding space; different spaces remain possible for independent namespaces.
contract.existing_exceptions: Explicit fresh-store policy, preparation/role corrections, strict overflow/vector checks and identity refusal remain. No guarantee of unchanged vectors or identity-free legacy-store use.
contract.proof: DI-18 plus DI-33: unchanged configuration fixtures and cross-subsystem extraction/graph/recall/maintenance/lifecycle/compaction/ingestion operations; source and representative normal/optimized installed proofs remain future work.

documentation_only_exemption.reason: Explicit request to place the discussed embedding-pool compatibility premise in the proposed REM.
documentation_only_exemption.scope: REM and its current planning/authority/status/check records only; exact prior council reports/requests, companion, store-policy approval and other unit authority preserved.
documentation_only_exemption.runtime_effect: None: no source, tests, runtime config, package metadata, dependency lock or existing store changes.
documentation_only_exemption.validation: Board/dashboard/document lifecycle/whitespace, JSON/hash/status coherence and preservation checks.

review_boundary: Prior council results remain historical for exact candidate bytes. No new council was invoked or inferred from this document-edit request.
